All Solutions

International Freight Forwarding

By sea and air, full and partial container loads (FCL/LCL) and urgent cargo, import and export, through the world's major ports and airports.

Overland Transport and Domestic Distribution

Border crossings and overland routes across the region, and delivery to every point in the country.

Customs Brokerage

Import clearance and export declarations, classification, licensing and liaison with the authorities.

e-Commerce

International e-commerce in both directions, from the warehouse to the customer's door.

Logistics and Warehousing

Logistics centers, inventory management, 3PL/4PL and assembly for export.

Solutions foryour industry.

All Industries

Humanitarian Aid

Fast delivery of equipment and aid to emergency zones, from the port to the distribution point, coordinated with authorities and organisations and available around the clock.

Automotive

Moving vehicles, parts and accessories from the manufacturer to the dealership and the garage, with dedicated storage and scheduled distribution across the country.

Pharma

Logistics for medicines and health products in a controlled cold chain, with full traceability, GDP compliance and dedicated distribution to pharmacies and medical institutions.

Food

Logistics for fast-moving products that demand availability, accuracy and continuous management of inventory and distribution all the way.

Defense

Logistics for complex projects and shipments that demand a high level of control, reliability and precision, tailored to the sector's unique requirements.

Projects

Oversized cargo and heavy equipment for projects, from route planning and permits to the lift and delivery on site, fully coordinated across every party.

Aerospace

Moving parts, engines and sensitive equipment for the aviation and space industry, with precision, control and full compliance with its standards.

Fashion

Flexible logistics for fashion and textiles, adapted to seasonality, shifting collection cycles and fast delivery to stores.

Thinking aboutthe road ahead

Responsible logistics is measured not only by what reaches its destination, but by how it gets there. At Orian, environmental responsibility, quality standards and ethical conduct are part of everyday work - out of a commitment to people, to the environment and to the way the company keeps growing.
